curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How do five seemingly random paths of bad judgment and sudden violence collide at the exact same minute?
curatedMovie.description: Over the course of a single chaotic evening, five separate storylines and characters barrel through deceit and crime, hurtling toward an interconnected collision at exactly 11:14 p.m.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, suspenseful, and darkly comic. An interlocking crime scramble that rewards focused attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Greg Marcks orchestrates a fast-paced, 86-minute crime puzzle where seemingly scattered mishaps snap together with dark comedic irony.
